RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Endpoint.Name: Companion app endpoint
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Endpoint.Hint: Full URL of the herald function, e.g. https://your-site.netlify.app/api/herald. Leave blank to disable pushing.
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Secret.Name: Shared secret
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Secret.Hint: Must match HERALD_SHARED_SECRET on the companion app. This authorises calendar writes to the app only — it is NOT a Supabase key, and anyone who can open a GM console can read it.
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Enabled.Name: Push the calendar
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Off pauses all pushes without clearing the endpoint or secret.
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Verbose.Name: Log every push
RIPPERS_HERALD.Settings.Verbose.Hint: Writes one console line per successful push. Failures are always logged.
